subject: Renewal QBR roadmap demo — accessibility needs & recording exemptions
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@alterahealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR roadmap demo — accessibility & recording questions

Hi Grace / Marissa / Jonas,

Thanks again for the heads-up on next quarter's renewal QBR. We want to make sure the roadmap demo meets our accessibility and privacy requirements. A couple of things from our side: 

- Some slides will include de-identified clinical examples but may still trigger our internal PHI review; our legal/compliance team requires that any recorded segment containing clinical vignettes be either redacted or kept off the public recording.
- We need live captions and an ASL interpreter for part of the session. Is Redwood able to provide a live-captioning stream (or integrate with our caption vendor)?
- If a recording is taken, we need a private, time-limited URL and the ability for our team to request redaction clipping within 72 hours.

I attached a short note with our redaction checklist (redactions_requirements.pdf). Could we also confirm a dry-run window before the customer-visible demo so we can validate captions and redaction flow?

Procurement is also asking for a final SOW and an expected DocuSign ETA — cc'd procurement@alterahealth.com in case that helps.

Would next week (Apr 29–May 2) work for a dry-run? Early mornings PT are preferable for our stakeholders.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Customer Success — Altera Health
Elena.Ruiz@alterahealth.com

Attachment: redactions_requirements.pdf (1 page PDF)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@alterahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR roadmap demo — accessibility & recording questions

Elena — thanks for the note and the checklist, very helpful. Quick replies and a proposed plan: 

- Live captions: we can enable a captions stream (we use a partner integration) or accept your vendor's RTMP/Caption feed. Either way we'll run it in the dry-run to verify latency and accuracy.
- Recording policy: we can publish a private, expiring recording link and support redaction requests. I'll escalate with Ops on the 72-hour clip/redact SLA you mentioned.
- Dry-run: we can do a 30-minute technical rehearsal + a separate 45-minute content dry-run if you want. If stakeholders prefer a single slot, propose 30 Apr 2025, 10:00–10:45 PT for a combined run-through.

I am looping in Jonas (legal/compliance) to confirm the redaction path and whether a special NDAs/clauses are needed for recorded material. Jonas — could you confirm whether Altera's redaction checklist triggers any specific retention settings on our side?

I've attached our internal note on the secure recording process (secure-recording-process.md) so you can see how we host private links and the retention controls.

If that window is tight, Marissa can help surface alternative slots and coordinate with your procurement for the SOW/DocuSign flow.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: secure-recording-process.md (text)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@alterahealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, procurement@alterahealth.com
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR roadmap demo — accessibility & recording questions

Thanks Grace — that sounds promising. A few clarifications: 

- The segments with potential PHI are the clinical vignette (approx 8–10 min) and the case-study Q&A (approx 12 min) at the end. If you can exclude those from the public recording and produce an admin-only recording we can accept that.
- We do want the captions for the whole session (not just the non-PHI parts). Our caption vendor (captionworks@alteravendor.com) can join the rehearsal; do you need contact details or will Redwood initiate the integration?
- Procurement attached a revised SOW (SOW_v2.pdf) — we're trying to close the paper this week. If you can send a DocuSign link for Redwood's signature, that would speed things up.

Preferred dry-run windows: Tue Apr 29, 8:30–9:15 PT or Thu May 1, 10:00–10:45 PT. The main demo date that works for execs is Fri May 2, 09:00–10:00 PT (but we can be flexible if Redwood prefers a different end time).

Elena
(Procurement cc'ed as requested)

Attachment: SOW_v2.pdf (3 pages)
External contacts: captionworks@alteravendor.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@alterahealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR roadmap demo — accessibility & recording questions

Elena / Grace — I reviewed the checklist and the SOW. Short confirmation from legal/compliance: 

- Redwood can provide a tenant-restricted recording URL (expires) and we can process redaction requests submitted within 72 hours. We will flag the recording with a metadata tag "PHI-potential" so access is limited to pin-holders on the link.
- For PHI-containing segments we recommend two mitigations: 1) exclude those minutes from the public recording and 2) if a recording is still needed for internal review, capture a separate secure recording (stored in a locked bucket with stricter IAM). We can support either.
- No additional NDA is required for short redaction processing; your SOW language about retention and clipping rights is sufficient, but please ensure the SOW includes "admin-only recording" language.

Operationally: I suggest we run the combined technical/content dry-run on Thu May 1, 10:00–10:45 PT (that gives your team a morning rehearsal and one business day buffer before the May 2 exec demo). Grace, please schedule a 30-minute Ops-only slot the day before if Ops wants a separate loop.

DocuSign: procurement link looks fine; when you send the DocuSign request, cc me and I will confirm the signature path.

Attachment: compliance-snapshot.xlsx (summary of controls)

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
